component.name: GARbro
component.summary: Browse, preview and extract game resources
浏览、预览与提取游戏资源

description.p: Explore game archives and nested directories, preview images, audio, text and binary data, and extract resources with configurable encoding and output limits.
浏览游戏归档和嵌套目录，预览图像、音频、文本及二进制数据，并按所选编码和输出限制提取资源。
Create archives with supported writers and convert images or audio. Audio plays only when requested. Game-specific variants may require a password or game scheme.
使用支持写入的格式创建归档，转换图像或音频。音频需手动播放，部分游戏变体需要密码或游戏方案。
This migration preview has compatibility limits. Windows Media Foundation audio is unavailable on Linux. Select a folder when an archive needs sibling indexes or key files.
本迁移预览版有兼容性限制。Linux 不支持依赖 Windows Media Foundation 的音频。归档需要同目录索引或密钥辅助文件时，请选择整个文件夹。
